_source: Pre-first-run fallback only: the president pipeline recomputes these from the stored presidential population every run (president_scorer.compute_president_reference) and writes /data/president_reference.json, which takes precedence. Values are the 2026-07 measurements previously hand-typed into president_scorer.py: approval and trend over the 15 presidents with UCSB approval pages (Truman onward), election margin over 42 elected presidencies (UCSB, rescaled onto the popular-margin scale), C-SPAN 2021 Historians Survey totals over 44 rated presidents (Cleveland once). gdp_growth_prewar/postwar: Maddison Project US real GDP through historical_gdp.compute_term_gdp_growth, presidencies 1817-2016 (combined where the annual series can't separate them); jobs_per_year: BLS household-survey employment (datasets/employment-us), presidencies since 1945. Both are proxies for the pipeline's own MeasuringWorth / BLS payroll series, which replace them on the first run; written by backend/scripts/research_president_scores.py. rulemaking_finalized_pct has no fallback: Agency Alignment is omitted until the first run measures it.
